message.content: For the California Insurance Commissioner race, Jane Kim's platform centers on a single-payer public natural disaster insurance system to replace the FAIR Plan, minimum loss ratios of 70 percent for auto and 65 percent for homeowners insurance, closing the occupation-based rate discrimination loophole in auto pricing, and a public insurer performance dashboard with company-by-company claims data. On Gaza, Kim has pledged to reject war-lobby support and stated she favors divesting public funds from war crimes and genocide, though this is a stated pledge rather than a legislative act she has carried through. By contrast, Ben Allen supported deleting anti-Israel language from California Democratic Party resolutions in 2019, visited Kibbutz K'far Aza in December 2023, and in 2026 opposes BDS while affirming Israel's right to exist and defend itself. Kim holds endorsements from CAIR Action, AROC Action, and Ro Khanna, with Vote for Peace listing her as an Ally; Allen is rated Opposed by Vote for Peace and holds an endorsement from the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club.
